    AI Overview
    Yes, most banks in the USA are
    open on Easter Monday    . Because it is not a federal holiday, major institutions like Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and the Federal Reserve operate on their regular business hours. While online banking remains available, some small local branches might have limited hours. 
    Key Details for Easter Monday: 
    • Federal Reserve: Open.
    • Major Banks: Generally open for normal business.
    • Post Office & Mail: Regular service.
    • Stock Market:
      Open.
       
    Note: While Good Friday is sometimes observed in certain states, Easter Monday has no federal, state, or banking closures in the U.S..
